privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.section1Desc: When you use Pstream, we collect certain personal data to provide and improve our service. This includes:
privacyPage.section2Desc: Under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the lawful bases we rely on for processing this information are:
privacyPage.s2L1: <0>Contractual Necessity:</0> To provide you with the streaming aggregation and profile features you signed up for.
privacyPage.s2L2: <0>Legitimate Interests:</0> To analyze general platform usage and improve performance (using strictly anonymized data).
privacyPage.s2L3: <0>Usage Data:</0> Watch history, continue-watching progress, and My List entries — stored exclusively in your authenticated account and never shared.
privacyPage.section3Desc: Your data is securely stored using Supabase (our backend provider). We use Row-Level Security (RLS) to ensure that your watch history and profiles are strictly isolated and only accessible by your authenticated account.
privacyPage.s3L1: <0>Log IP Addresses:</0> We do not log, store, or process your IP address in any persistent form.
privacyPage.s3L2: <0>Use Tracking Cookies:</0> We do not deploy any advertising, analytics, or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacyPage.s3L3: <0>Sell Your Data:</0> We do not sell, rent, or trade any personal data to third parties, ever.
privacyPage.s3L4: <0>Fingerprint Your Browser:</0> We do not perform browser fingerprinting or any form of device identification.
privacyPage.s4L1: <0>Access:</0> Request copies of your personal data.
privacyPage.s4L2: <0>Erasure:</0> Request that we erase your personal data ("Right to be Forgotten"). You can delete your account and all associated data directly from the Settings page.
privacyPage.section5Desc: We use third-party APIs (such as TMDB for metadata and Cloudflare Turnstile for bot protection). These services operate under their own privacy policies. We proxy sensitive API requests through our backend to minimize client-side data exposure.
privacyPage.section6Desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact the repository maintainers.
privacyPage.section7Desc: Under UK GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacyPage.s7L1: <0>Right of Access:</0> Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPage.s7L2: <0>Right to Erasure:</0> Request deletion of your personal data (the "Right to be Forgotten"). You can delete your account and all associated data directly from the Settings page at any time.
privacyPage.s7L3: <0>Right to Rectification:</0> Request correction of any inaccurate personal data we hold.
privacyPage.s7L4: <0>Right to Object:</0> Object to processing of your personal data where we rely on legitimate interests.
privacyPage.section8Desc: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact the repository maintainers via the Contact page or the email address listed therein.
privacyPage.s1L1: <0>Account Information:</0> Your email address when you sign up via Supabase Auth.
privacyPage.s1L2: <0>Profile Data:</0> Names, avatars, and settings for any profiles created under your account.
privacyPage.s1L3: <0>Usage Data:</0> Your watch history, continue watching progress, and "My List" preferences.
privacyPage.s4L3: <0>Rectification:</0> Correct any information you believe is inaccurate.

dmcaPage.section4Title: 4. Important Limitation — We Can Only Remove Links
dmcaPage.section4Desc: Because Pstream does not host any media files, we are only able to remove the link from our search index. We cannot remove, delete, or take down the underlying video or media file itself — that content is stored on independent third-party servers entirely outside our control. To have the actual media file removed, you must contact the operator of the third-party hosting service directly.
